members.name: Shilpa Rajput
members.biography: Passionate psychologist with over two years of clinical training experience at Santosh Hospital and 6 months experience as a behavioural therapist at Vqura Child Development Center, dedicated to supporting mental health and fostering positive change in individuals. Clinical experience in diverse settings such as psychiatry, pediatrics, and rehabilitation. Research and publication on Internet Addiction and its relation to Psychopathology and Self-Esteem among Medical Students. Active participation in workshops and certifications on mindfulness, suicide prevention, and biostatistics.
